'''Brial Sullor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as a novelist a few [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], she attended the launch of the luxury [[Hovertrain/Legends|repulsortrain]] ''[[Gem of Alderaan]]'' on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].
